VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to confirm criterion (1)—that the *stale-quote eviction bug is actually fixed*. The CI log shows 31 tests pass, but there's no evidence that any test specifically covers the stale-quote eviction behavior. A passing suite proves nothing was broken; it doesn't prove the bug was fixed unless a regression test reproduces the original failure. The code diff for the "small guard" was also not provided for review. Criterion (2) is supported (clean package.json diff), but without proof the fix targets the actual bug, both criteria are not satisfied.
